alternative_fix_sites: quarry/planner.py::run_select (any stable descending sort, e.g. sorting with a negated or inverted key)
notes: Descending ORDER BY items are sorted ascending and then reversed, which reverses rows that tie on that item. With several ORDER BY items, a descending first item reverses the order established by the later items. Descending order without ties is correct (public test). Probes cover single and multiple keys, LIMIT/OFFSET, NULL keys, DISTINCT, GROUP BY with aggregate keys, positions and joins.
